summary: Retested Productify public APIs and critical marketplace UI flows. API regression passed 4/4; browser checks passed for mobile load, Google demo login, category filtering, cart, and authenticated MOCK checkout.

minor.issue: Auth uses bearer tokens in localStorage and backend sets allow_credentials=false; required httpOnly-cookie/credentials auth hardening was not implemented.

integration_issues.issue: No dashboard UI routes or controls are present in the reviewed App.js; only backend approval endpoints were verified.

action_items: Consider migrating auth persistence from localStorage bearer tokens to httpOnly cookies with explicit credentialed CORS if required by the auth playbook.
Implement or clarify seller/admin dashboard UI scope; current frontend only shows a selling CTA and backend approval APIs.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js stores JWT in localStorage, increasing XSS exposure; align auth storage and CORS behavior with the documented cookie requirements.
The frontend has no actual seller/admin dashboard despite the requested seller/admin dashboard feature.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ seller/rental/buyer records through regression tests; rental was approved. No seeded production records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google demo login now returns 200 with email/name-only payload; mobile and desktop marketplace flows pass. Dashboard UI and cookie-based auth remain unverified/unimplemented.
rca of the issue: The documented auth playbook requires httpOnly cookies and credentialed CORS, but server.py explicitly sets allow_credentials=False while App.js persists the bearer token in localStorage. Dashboard gaps stem from App.js containing only marketplace, cart, and auth modal components with no dashboard route/component.
